mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDP indicates strong economic demand, which should positively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: GDP growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative over the 60-day horizon in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in unemployment rate above 8% signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: Unemployment rate rises above 8% but S&P 500 returns remain positive in more than 30% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When CPI increases and federal funds rate is high, inflationary pressures may erode corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: CPI increases and FEDFUNDS are high but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 35% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing industrial production suggests economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: Industrial production increases but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, high federal funds rates lead to decreased corporate investments and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: Federal funds rate is high but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 35% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts indicates weak demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: Housing starts are below threshold but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment without a corresponding decrease in unemployment rate suggests labor market inefficiencies, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases and UNRATE does not decrease
failure_condition: Payroll employment increases without unemployment decrease but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 35% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing retail sales indicate strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: Retail sales increase but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.
